title: Fee Schedule Addendum: Wire and Early Closure Charges on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
Four per-tier charges and windows complete the fee schedule of Savings & Money Market Accounts: the fee per outgoing domestic wire from the account, the fee per incoming wire credited to it, the fee when the owner closes the account within the early closure window, and the length of that window in calendar days after the opening date.

| Tier | Outgoing domestic wire | Incoming wire | Early closure fee | Early closure window |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Starter Savings | 30.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 90 calendar days |
| Statement Savings | 30.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 90 calendar days |
| Goal Builder Savings | 30.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 90 calendar days |
| Money Market Account | 30.00 USD | 15.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 90 calendar days |
| Premier Money Market | 20.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 90 calendar days |
| Private Client Money Market | 10.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 25.00 USD | 90 calendar days |

The outgoing wire charge falls as the tier rises, from 30.00 USD on the four lower tiers to 20.00 USD on Premier Money Market and 10.00 USD on Private Client Money Market. Incoming wires are credited free of charge on the two top tiers and carry 15.00 USD elsewhere.

The early closure fee is 25.00 USD on five tiers and 0.00 USD on Starter Savings. The window is the same 90 calendar days after the opening date throughout the product, so no tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts carries a longer or shorter early closure window than another.
